criteria.requirement: Add jsonutils.JSONLWriter(stream,*,binary=False,encoding="utf-8",dumps=None), write(value), write_many(iterable), flush() and successful count. Serialize and validate one complete JSON text before writing exactly one LF-terminated record; reject physical CR/LF, nonstring or invalid custom serializer results without writing that record. Binary mode encodes first; preserve caller stream ownership and lazy consumption, detect reported short writes, propagate serialization/I/O errors and keep prior successful records/count. No whole-batch rollback or silent stream closure.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
